transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam. I am having a dreadful time with my television puck. I pressed the little reset pinhole on the bottom, and now it's stuck on a screen showing a picture of the remote control, and nothing works!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you sort out that TV puck, Dorothy. Before we begin, can you confirm the first line of your address and your postcode for account security?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dorothy Higgins, 7 Primrose Lane, Harrogate, HG2 9BL.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And can you confirm the four-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 6219.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Dorothy, that passes verification. So what I understand is that after doing a factory reset on the Stream puck, the television is stuck on the pairing graphic and the remote isn't responding to any button presses, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly it. The screen shows two hands holding a remote control pointing at the box, but pressing any button does nothing at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you press the power or volume buttons on the remote right now, does the small LED light at the top of the remote flash any color?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It flashes a tiny red light twice whenever I press a button.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you changed the batteries in the remote control recently?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I put brand new Duracell batteries in just twenty minutes ago before calling you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check the physical setup, is the Stream puck connected to HDMI port 1 or HDMI port 2 on your television?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is plugged into HDMI 1 on the back of the Samsung television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is the small white light on the front of the Stream puck solid white or flashing amber?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is a solid white light, quite bright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is there any object blocking the front of the puck, like books or a soundbar?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, it sits right out on the open wooden TV cabinet table.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, clear line of sight helps during the initial Bluetooth discovery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, I made sure it had plenty of breathing room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the television remote control for your TV is separate from our voice remote, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have the black Samsung remote sitting on the side table.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's great. The double red flash indicates the remote is still paired to the puck's old Bluetooth profile, but the puck's memory was wiped by the reset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was so worried the puck had broken completely and I'd miss my evening shows. It's so frustrating when technology just stops working like this!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We just need to clear the remote's stored Bluetooth cache and re-link them. Hold on for just a moment while I pull up the exact button sequence.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Dorothy. I will guide you through the reset process step by step.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright Liam, I'm ready with the remote in my hand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: First, I need you to press and hold down the 7 and 9 buttons together at the same time until the LED light at the top flashes red four times.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding 7 and 9 down now... One, two, three... Yes! It just flashed red four times rapidly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. That has completely wiped the old pairing from the remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The screen is still showing the remote graphic though.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's completely normal because they aren't linked yet. Obviously the puck cannot communicate with the remote until we re-establish Bluetooth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. What is the next step?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now point the remote directly at the Stream puck, about a foot away, and press and hold the 1 and 3 buttons together until the LED pulses blue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding 1 and 3 now... It's flashing blue slowly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep pointing it at the puck. Does the TV screen change?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! A little box popped up saying 'Remote control connected via Bluetooth'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. Now press the Home button with the picture of the house on the remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh wonderful! The main S-Net home screen with all the apps and live channels just appeared!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm what the remote LED does now, is it still flashing red twice when you press volume, or has it stopped flashing red?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No red flash at all now, the volume bar goes up and down smoothly on my television!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you use the directional arrow buttons to highlight BBC One and press the Select button in the center?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Doing that now... Yes, BBC News is playing with full sound and picture!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you test changing channels to ITV as well to make sure navigation is responsive?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Switched to ITV, crystal clear HD picture.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the voice search button working if you press the microphone icon, Dorothy?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressed it and said 'weather', and the forecast popped up on screen immediately. It's working better than before!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's fantastic. The firmware also re-calibrated the voice remote during the re-pairing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am so relieved. You made that so simple to follow, Liam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad we could get it sorted out so quickly for you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If the power goes off in a storm, will it forget the remote again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, normal power cuts or turning off at the wall will not erase the pairing. Only pressing that physical pinhole button does that.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will definitely steer clear of that little pinhole in future!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your TV or broadband that I can assist you with today, Dorothy?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, everything else is working beautifully. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Dorothy, and have a lovely evening watching your programmes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, goodbye.
